F.name: source_search
F.description: Search the shared audited robotics source view with a literal substring.

F.name: source_read
F.description: Read an allowlisted relative file; begin at 1; at most 200 lines.

F.name: scratch_execute
F.description: Execute standard-library Python in isolated scratch. Set result to a JSON value. Robot calls use documented proxy functions; each nested call consumes a tool call. No simulator or network access.

F.name: finish
F.description: End this actor trial; the evaluator decides the outcome privately.

F.name: act

F_adaptive.name: enable_capability
F_adaptive.description: Enable an available hardware capability for this episode; records your reason.

F_adaptive.name: read_capability
F_adaptive.description: Read an enabled capability; no arbitrary simulator queries.

F_adaptive.name: define_interface_tool
F_adaptive.description: Create or replace a named Python interface tool. Code runs only when called. params contains parsed arguments_json. Set result to JSON.

F_adaptive.name: call_interface_tool
F_adaptive.description: Execute the current version of a named interface tool in isolated scratch.

F_adaptive.name: probe_dynamics
F_adaptive.description: Measure numeric sensors before and after one bounded native command. All executed steps count in the episode; no reset or hidden state.

F_adaptive.name: revise_interface_notes
F_adaptive.description: Replace persistent per-episode interface notes: assumptions, measured response models, or operating conventions.

F_adaptive.name: restore_interface
F_adaptive.description: Restore an earlier interface revision. Does not undo robot movement or episode costs.

define_interface_tool.name: eef_position_mm
define_interface_tool.description: Read end-effector position in millimetres, preserving its frame.
define_interface_tool.code:
sample = read('robot.eef_position', 1000)
result = {'position_mm': [1000 * v for v in sample['value']], 'frame': sample['metadata']['frame'], 'simulator_step': sample['metadata']['simulator_step']}
define_interface_tool.reason: Make a reusable sensor conversion for this episode.

probe_dynamics.reason: Measure a local response; this fixture has synthetic constant sensors.

revise_interface_notes.notes: This documentation fixture has constant sensors; it is not a dynamics estimate.

additional_proprioception.description: Additional native robot encoders currently omitted from F

robot0_joint_acc.description: native joint accelerations in source joint order
robot0_joint_acc.units: rad/s^2 for hinge, m/s^2 for slide

eef_position_mm.description: Read end-effector position in millimetres, preserving its frame.

probe_dynamics.reason: Measure a local response; this fixture has synthetic constant sensors.
probe_dynamics.interpretation: Observed finite response to this command and state, including drift/contact; not a global Jacobian. Quaternion delta is a component difference, not an angular velocity.

eef_position_mm.description: Read end-effector position in millimetres, preserving its frame.
